subject: Executive sponsor: growth case, procurement asks, and risk triggers
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@luminaryhealth.com>, Marcus Lowe <marcus.lowe@luminaryhealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Executive sponsor: growth case, procurement asks, and risk triggers

Hi Priya / Marcus —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Short recap and ownership so we’re aligned at the exec level. I kept this high-level for your leadership readout.

Summary of business outcomes discussed:
- Reduce inference cost per session by 35–45% for your consumer chat flow while keeping p95 latency under 300ms.
- Improve model uptime and predictable throughput during morning peak (08:00–11:00 PT) to support 3x user growth next quarter.
- Centralize audit logs for clinical interactions to satisfy upcoming compliance review.

Top pain points you confirmed:
1) Current vendor variability: unpredictable latency under load and opaque cost spikes.
2) Procurement needs: SOC2 evidence, data residency controls, and a short legal turnaround for an initial pilot.
3) SRE burden: manual cache tuning and custom batching scripts tied up engineering.

Risks / triggers to highlight for your CFO / CISO:
- Security: need for SOC2 report and KMS integration for production keys.
- Ops: fallback plan required if dedicated capacity warms slower than estimate.
- Commercial: requested 60-day pilot pricing cap and provisional credits if p95 SLO missed.

Procurement path we propose (recommended):
1) Pilot statement of work (2 months) — includes dedicated pool sizing, SLA, and rollback policy.
2) Security evidence exchange (SOC2 + minimal infra diagram) — CS & security runbook included.
3) Legal: Redwood standard MSA + pilot SOW, target redlines within 10 business days.
4) If pilot meets metrics, convert to reserved capacity commitment (quarterly billing).

Open asks / owners:
- Priya: confirm pilot decision and internal exec sponsor (CISO or Head of Platform) by 11/12.
- Marcus: share internal performance baseline (QPS & p95 latency traces) — target: by 11/09.
- Hannah (me): I’ll drop a one-page pilot SOW and a SOC2 evidence checklist by end of day tomorrow.

Attachments: Luminary_Security_Questions.pdf (security checklist), Pilot_SLA_Draft.docx (strawman SLOs).

Next steps (short cadence):
- 11/05: Brief internal call (30m) with your platform lead if you want to walk the SOW.
- 11/12: Decision point on pilot go/no-go.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the SOW and a concrete pricing cap for the pilot.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@luminaryhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 17:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive sponsor: growth case, procurement asks, and risk triggers

Hannah —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from our side:
- We can be the exec sponsor on the business side; I’ll loop in R&D head (Marcus) for the technical baseline.
- SOC2 is a hard requirement. Please include the SOC2 attestation and a short list of which controls map to our PHI handling questions.
- The 60-day pilot with a pricing cap works in principle, but I need procurement to see an estimated spend number.

I’ll push to get the QPS and p95 traces to you by Monday (11/09).

Two small asks for your SOW: include an explicit rollback/fail-safe so we don’t hit production users in the pilot, and add an option to pause ingestion to staging if a compliance blocker appears.

–Priya
VP, Digital Experience
Luminary Health
priya.shah@luminaryhealth.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 07:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fw: Executive sponsor: growth case, procurement asks, and risk triggers

Hannah / Jonas —

Forwarding Priya’s note. Quick internal alignment:
- Jonas: can you validate sizing assumptions (dedicated GPU pool warmup times) and confirm fallback (we can route to hosted smaller model with increased latency) by EOD?
- Pricing: I think we should offer a pilot cap that’s simple — $9k/month capped for two months with a one-time $2k onboarding fee. Hannah, if you want margin flexibility, request up to 20% discount approval.
- Security: I’ll attach the SOC2 excerpt and a short control mapping for PHI — we need to hand this to Priya along with the SOW.

I’ll stand by for Jonas’ sizing and will prep a concise pricing note for Hannah to include in the SOW.

Thanks,
Sean
Senior Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@luminaryhealth.com>, Marcus Lowe <marcus.lowe@luminaryhealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive sponsor: growth case, procurement asks, and risk triggers

Priya / Marcus —

Thanks — attached is the one-page pilot SOW (Pilot_SLA_Draft.docx) plus the security checklist PDF. Summary of concrete items we’ll deliver by 11/06: 
- Finalized pilot SOW with pricing cap ($9k/mo cap, $2k onboarding) and rollback language. Owner: Hannah.
- SOC2 control mapping for PHI and sample audit artifact export. Owner: Sean.
- Sizing and fallback confirmation (warmup and routing). Owner: Jonas — ETA EOD 11/05.

If all good I’ll get the SOW into a DocuSign link and loop legal to start a 10-business-day redline window.

If you want, we can do a 20-minute readout for your CISO on 11/08 — simple slide pack + control mapping.

Hannah

[Attachment stubs: Luminary_Security_Questions.pdf (application-level checklist), Pilot_SLA_Draft.docx (one-page SOW strawman)]
